purpose: discovery only; frozen EDHREC snapshots untouched
caveats: EDHREC inclusion = num_decks/potential_decks; usage is discovery evidence only, never an instruction. Kefka's cEDH page is a large sample (about 2232 decks, self-tagged cEDH, not tournament-verified); the general page (about 32.5k decks) is dominated by casual lists. Cards the owner removed or rejected in the 2026-10-14 rebuild (Exotic Orchard, The One Ring, Opposition Agent, Faerie Mastermind, Cyclonic Rift, Dauthi Voidwalker, Birgi and others) are inadmissible here regardless of inclusion. Repo EDHTop16 one-year aggregates (data/grixis/candidates/tournament/kefka-court-mage.json, retrieved 2026-10-16, 1396 entries) are cited where they cover a card; conversion is observational and confounded by pilot skill and meta.
